title: From Unstructured Recall to Schema-Grounded Memory: Reliable AI Memory via Iterative, Schema-Aware Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2604.27906v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Persistent AI memory is often reduced to a retrieval problem: store prior interactions as text, embed them, and ask the model to recover relevant context later. This design is useful for thematic recall, but it is mismatched to the kinds of memory that agents need in production: exact facts, current state, updates and deletions, aggregation, relations, negative queries, and explicit unknowns. These operations require memory to behave less like search and more like a system of record.   This paper argues that reliable external AI memory must be schema-grounded. Schemas define what must be remembered, what may be ignored, and which values must never be inferred. translated_title: 从非结构化回忆到基于模式的记忆：通过迭代、模式感知提取实现可靠的AI记忆
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.27906v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：持久性AI记忆常被简化为一个检索问题：将先前的交互存储为文本，嵌入它们，并让模型稍后检索相关上下文。这种设计适用于主题回忆，但与智能体在生产环境中所需的记忆类型不匹配：精确事实、当前状态、更新与删除、聚合、关系、否定查询和显式未知。这些操作要求记忆更像一个记录系统，而非搜索工具。本文认为，可靠的外部AI记忆必须基于模式。模式定义了必须记住的内容、可以忽略的内容，以及绝不能推断的值。我们提出了一种迭代、模式感知的写入路径，将记忆摄取分解为对象检测、字段检测和字段值提取，并带有验证门控、局部重试和状态化提示控制。其结果是，将解释从读取路径转移到写入路径。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于模式的迭代写入路径，将记忆摄取分解为对象、字段和值提取，并通过验证和重试确保可靠记忆，从而将AI记忆从检索问题转变为记录系统问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an iterative, schema-aware write path that decomposes memory ingestion into object, field, and value extraction with validation and retries, shifting AI memory from retrieval to a system of record.
